tei:div.tei:p: che mchog dpal dgu'i bzlog bcol/ hūm̐: rnam thar gsum ldan rdo rje btsun mo'i dbyings: gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: bcom ldan dpal chen che mchog he ru ka: 'khor 'das kun gyi spyi dpal dbyings nas bzhengs: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: dpal chen thugs las sprul pa'i sras mchog bzhi: khro bo yab yum bcu dang lce spyang brgyad: sgo skyong phyag rgya bzhi ldan la sogs pa: che mchog yon tan lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'di rol la: rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi: sems dang sems byung rgyu 'bras 'chol ba las: byung ba'i nad gdon chag che nyam nga dang: phyi nang 'byung ba dgra gshed 'khrugs pa'i rkyen: 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug dang: byad phur rbod gtong than ltas ngan pa kun: zlog cing sgyur ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol: hūm̐: rnam shes tshogs brgyad gnas su dag pa las: sgrub sde chen po brgyad kyi tshom 278) bur shar: shar phyogs zla gam 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: me long ye shes badz+ra he ru ka: zhe sdang 'joms pa'i dpa' bo chen po ste: thugs las sprul pa'i khrag 'thung rigs lnga dang: gnas dang yul gyi ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dbang mo nyer brgyad sgo srung gdong can bzhi: yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs sha khrag= hūm̐: lho phyogs thod mkhar lcags kyi pho brang nas: mnyam nyid ye shes rat+na he ru ka: nga rgyal 'joms pa'i dpa' bo chen po ste: rtsa ba'i lha drug rgyan gyi lha brgyad dang: bdud dang gshin rje bye ba dgu khri bcas: 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs sha khrag= hūm̐:nub phyogs zla gam dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas: sor rtogs ye shes pad+ma he ru ka: 'dod chags 'joms pa'i dpa' bo chen po ste: rta mgrin rgyal po dregs pa 'dul ba'i lha:

dmus long khyi spyang bya khyung sgo ma bzhi: pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs sha khrag= hūm̐: byang phyogs ljang nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas: 379) bya grub ye shes karma he ru ka: phrag dog 'joms pa'i dpa' bo chen po ste: rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum sras dang bcas: khro bcu khra thabs sgo skyong phyag brnyan tshogs: phur pa phrin las lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs sha khrag= hūm̐: shar lho srid pa bde 'gro'i dkyil 'khor nas: klong gyur ye shes bla med he ru ka: yul drug dbyings la sbyor ba'i ma lnga dang: rje mo bcu bzhi sman mo lnga bcu brgyad: sring mo sgo ma'i tshogs rnams dbyings nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs sha khrag= hūm̐: lho nub rig 'dzin thod pa'i pho brang nas: 'da' ka ye shes rig 'dzin drag po rtsal: rnam par smin dang tshe dbang phyag rgya che: lhun grub rig 'dzin grub pa'i rig 'dzin brgyad: sgo skyong dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dbyings nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs sha khrag= hūm̐: nub byang dregs pa 'dul ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: dbyings grol ye shes badz+ra he ru ka: nga rgyal 'joms pa'i dpa' bo chen po ni: bcom ldan dpal chen dregs pa kun 'dul dang: 380) srid pa spyi 'dul sde dpon sum cur bcas: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs= hūm̐: byang shar drag sngags rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: mtha' grol ye shes karma he ru ka: gti mug 'joms pa'i dpa' bo chen po ste: bcom ldan dpal chen stobs ldan nag po ni: yum chen 'byung ba lnga yi bdag mo dang: sngags bdag dregs pa bco brgyad lha srin bcas: dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: dgra bgegs= oṃ badz+ra tsan+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa: dgra bo'i srog la baṃ ril thun dza: baṃ myags mā ra ya rbad: tsa tsa dun ril baṃ laṃ srog la myags: mā ra ya myags tsa dza:
dun ril baṃ srog la rbad: srog dun baṃ myagasaḥ tsa la dun rbad mā ra ya: srog thun bh+yo: breng shag rbad: dge'o//
